2026-10-02 (America/Los_Angeles): macro publication queue migration. Exact original workload member IDs, member hashes and owned evidence directories are preserved. Previous issue bodies/pins are archived with this migration. Global release/certificate and current region envelopes are refreshed; nine retained IDs changed (six footprints, three present-day names), with no historical claim transfer. Newly sourced locations are assigned separately to eight bounded supplemental packets. This update does not approve region interiors, original source completeness or location-attribute imports.

Raised/recorded: 2026-10-02 (America/Los_Angeles). Regional scope is pinned to the published reference; this task is not a claim that its interiors are approved.

Parent: #7. **Unclaimable regional umbrella**; workers take its bounded children, never the whole region indefinitely.

Region ID: `framework:region:southeastern-north-america:8606d9313330`.
Continent: North America; subcontinent: Northern America.
Release: `geography:review:df86cbaeaf2e18f16ddf2906ef089768baac22f4428e28ed0a4724296cbb413e` (v5).
Hierarchy SHA-256: `03d23534f87cdd0582bcb228780f00f65090bec2e8a760acbab528383f28549d`.
Footprints SHA-256: `2ac42eeb9fef8af923a0d4c4e55af49ca0a103de891ffbfb2c1181ad75950286`.
Macro certificate SHA-256: `979afaf22e10dc936ecfe80a8cd288b2ef33d8c7bf509aba9fae4255e3d94d6e`.
Frozen region geometry SHA-256: `aaecdd36df74e8bfbfdff18986725ebca3981f68227ab59eecf92769475edcb2`.
Frozen region member IDs SHA-256: `b13d0db6a5592d678f7f7edb58da12a48b9369efe99f09d8952a0f010785c1a8`.
Durable baseline: `data/macro-foundation/regional-handoffs.json.gz` and `current-membership-inventory.json.gz` in current main.

Account for every one of this region's **1422 locations, 19 provinces and 4 areas**. Initial source/semantic evidence is partitioned into 6 disjoint review packets. Packet workload scopes are not new geographic units; shared area/province evidence is integrated once.

Initial packet inventory (each will have its own linked issue):
- `regional-review:599d6fe712bbbcae` — 245 locations — Bermuda, East South Central
- `regional-review:528e53393a4376b4` — 279 locations — East South Central, South Atlantic
- `regional-review:e5d9b45b0ad3ed31` — 268 locations — South Atlantic
- `regional-review:2353eb2f714cba0c` — 160 locations — South Atlantic
- `regional-review:508c7e9f3a462f8f` — 254 locations — West South Central
- `regional-review:6fce33d53fdff81e` — 216 locations — West South Central

Required complete-branch acceptance:
- All initial batches reviewed with exact membership proof.
- All resulting sourced correction and source coverage children complete, or justified explicitly approved exceptions.
- Every area/province/location semantic purpose approved; correct full bottom-up hierarchy; identity/crosswalk/history/footprint preservation.
- Canonical-grid island and enclave representation verified; independent overlap/coverage/source-gap results.
- Approve and publish complete branch certificate with current release pins and exact subjects before Luna location-attribute imports.

Known named-land checklist (routing does not certify footprint coverage):
- Bermuda: existing-source-territories-present; full-named-land-and-subordinate-island-coverage-unverified

Supplemental macro verification is tracked in #40. Interior workers preserve the declared outer scope, coordinate changes with neighboring regions and the designated publisher, and revalidate release/member hashes if upstream geography changes. Source gaps and shared boundaries cannot be silently waived. Initial reviews do not modify geography.

New location-attribute imports remain blocked until this entire branch is approved and published with exact permitted subject IDs and release pins. Completing the initial packets alone cannot close this umbrella; create and complete bounded sourced correction/source-restoration children, followed by its integration/approval child. Research may collect source-only evidence meanwhile.
